# Daley Organics — llms.txt
# Overview for AI language models and crawlers

## About
Daley Organics is a premium organic soil and fertilizer company based in Grants Pass, Oregon (Rogue Valley). Founded by Cameron Daley, the company is committed to sustainable agriculture and soil health.

## Products
- **Daley's Mix** — Elite professional blend. 21 organic amendments + complete fertilizer. $140/yd³.
- **Premium Soil Mix** — Foundation blend. 20 amendments + complete fertilizer. $130/yd³.
- **Merlin Blend** — High-volume landscape and garden mix. $55/yd³.
- **Grow Blend (5-4-2)** — Organic vegetative growth fertilizer.
- **Bloom Blend (2-7-7)** — High-phosphorus organic flowering fertilizer.
- **Premium Organic Compost** — 100% organic compost for soil rehabilitation.

## Ordering

- Delivery available for bulk orders (10 yard minimum) with special arrangements.
